reviews.title: Keeps getting worse
reviews.text:
This app used to be great. This year? An absolute disaster. Not only did it cost me money, it arguably cost me my fantasy season.

The biggest issue is the sheer inconsistency of the advice. Player projections and predictions have been wildly off, and different features within the SAME app routinely contradict one another. The “Optimal Lineup” recommendations frequently conflict with the individual “Who Should I Start?” player comparisons. So which one are we supposed to trust?

The Waiver Wire Assistant is equally flawed. On the rare occasion it identifies a worthwhile pickup, its recommendations can completely flip the following week without any logical explanation. For example, I was told a player was a must-add for both immediate and rest-of-season value. The following week, I was advised to drop that same player despite no injury, no significant depth-chart change, and no obvious reason for the reversal.

There are also serious data-integrity issues. ESPN roster and injury designations are updated well before FantasyPros reflects them. Players can remain listed as questionable for HOURS after ESPN has officially ruled them out. For a tool people rely on to make time-sensitive lineup decisions, that’s unacceptable.

And one final thought: if FantasyPros is planning to lean more heavily on ChatGPT-generated data and recommendations, please proceed with caution. ChatGPT can’t even consistently identify players’ bye weeks correctly. AI is only as good as the data behind it.

reviews.title: App Sucks
reviews.text:
It treats every format like the same 12-team redraft. Matchups, your actual roster construction, and dynasty value get flattened into “where our experts ranked him.” I’ve been told to sit guys who actually produce and start two receivers on the same struggling offense. Projections have been so far off they were useless the week I needed them. Compiling a bunch of rankings is not the same as helping your team.

What I wanted vs. what I got

I wanted league sync that actually reflects Sleeper/Yahoo/ESPN, start/sit that accounts for my scoring and roster, and tools that don’t crash when I analyze a draft. I got a slower, uglier app than last year, features stripped or paywalled, and recommendations I can get for free (and often better) from the same sites they scrape.
If you’re casual and just want pretty ECR lists, maybe it still works. If you actually manage multiple leagues, run dynasty, and need the app to work on Sunday and draft night, skip it. I won’t renew. I’d rather do the research myself than pay for a tool that fights me and then tells me I have a 99% chance to lose after I already won.

reviews.title: Performance & Ads
reviews.text:
In fantasy football, timing is everything. If the app is unable to load quickly and an ad launches that stalls,lags, or worse…freezes the app, it slows down the ability for the end user to perform any transactional moves or leverage the insights to commit any transactions in their respective league, leaving the opportunity for their competitors to add or pick up a player for advantage.

This increases user frustration and overall app experience. Please consider minimizing the launch of the app and timing experience and when an ad should appear.

reviews.title: Downhill
reviews.text: I’ve subscribed to FantasyPros for football every year for at least a decade. I appreciated the consensus ranking niche that was revolutionary at the time but I feel it has gradually gone downhill, the past few years especially. This year was the ultimate low point—heading into my draft I downloaded the app once again and went to check it out for updates. For the first *3* players I clicked on the most recent news update was 274 days ago…about week 18 last year. Considering we’re in the final weeks before the season starts, that is ttally uncceptable. Unless somone contacts me with valid reasons to think differently and take this review down, I will pursue other apps going forward.

I would have to go back in and pick that team for that choice and then re-pick it through the choice. It was supposed to be and it would disappear. The more players we picked the more difficult it was to go back and find it so I think I need a refund.

reviews.title: Be Really Careful
reviews.text:
This application is not what it claims.  FantasyPros and it’s Draft Wizard app make all these claims about compiling and synthesizing expert information to allow you to make the best picks at all points in your draft.

Unfortunately, that is just not the case.  I have used the app to do numerous mock drafts for my CBS fantasy baseball league and it consistently gives me the same inaccurate information again. For instance, I’ll be in the 10th round of a draft and I’ll say overall, who are the best four pics right now?  The application will say. Paul Goldschmidt first base.,  pitcher Dillion Cease and Ryan Helsey.  But if I then click on who are the best first basement available all of a sudden there are two first base above Paul Goldschmidt.  I will then toggle over to starting pictures and there are three pictures ahead of Dillon Cease.  There is just information that is provided and I realize it’s probably not possible to make a perfect app, but this one falls awfully short and if you rely on it for your draft you will be really disappointed

reviews.title: glitchy

Starting with draft-wizard advising me to make nonsensical picks, but the worst was auto-pilot (in which fp sets your roster for you, either to replace injured players or to optimize). Either way, there were several leagues in which inactive players would start or a position slot would be left empty despite having a viable alternative on the bench. i paid 60$ for the fp upgrade in addition to my league fees and expect that money to not be wasted.
